feature: The menu bar icon's menu starts with New and Open
summary: Clicking the Photonz icon in the menu bar now shows New, New from Clipboard, Open and Open Recent at the top with the File menu's keys. Capture follows as its own section, then updates, settings and Quit.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default.
